comments.author: @johnpaul5696
comments.text: I started a painting business here in Arizona and did that for about 2 years, but I was constantly competing against unlicensed painters charging cheap prices. Eventually I got licensed and switched into kitchen and bath remodeling, and that changed everything. Now I’m no longer competing on price, and after almost 10 years in remodeling I stay booked out at least 3 months year round. There’s way less competition when you move into work that actually requires licensing, paperwork, permits, testing, and real experience to get into.
